# R2.7 — model-plane producer legs: emitters, routing arms, dialect corpus, K5

Ticket `docs/tickets/113_R2.7__model-plane-legs.md` (seq 113); stacked
on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.6` (#112); ADR-0338.
Offline-only: every cell is deterministic — `fixture`-verified at the
in-process kernel seam; no live/staging environment is touched or
claimed. DF-S1.18-1 machine cells discharged; its live
`Transport`/`CredentialPort`/`probe_profile`-live members stay BL-31.

## The seam (ADR-0338 D1–D2)

The sealed `router` slot now arms a driver-owned `RoutingPort`; the
driver owns ordering and every durable append:

```
router slot bound
  → model.route.decided          (before the call scope opens —
                                  durable ahead of the requested row)
  → model.call.attempt.started
  → model.call.attempt.completed | .failed
      .failed → ADR-0122 consult (error_actions)
        Retry   → model.call.attempt.started (same target)
        Reroute → model.surface.relowered (cross-profile)
                → model.rerouted
                → model.call.attempt.started (new target)
        GiveUp  → the call closes
  refusal → control.guard.fired{route_select} + select_refused close
```

Side rows the consult produces (`control.budget.{reserved,released}`,
`model.profile.status.changed`) drain through `take_rows` into the
same fenced append — CC3 durable-before-visible. All routing state is
a fold over the durable prefix (the `attempted` set, per-target counts,
reroute count, pending-fresh-decision) — resume/takeover re-arms the
lane with no session memory. Unbound lanes are byte-identical —
`r2_7_unbound_lane_is_byte_identical` pins it.

## The codecs + the arm cut (D3–D4)

- `RoutingPolicy::from_json` / `RoutingDecision::from_json` — strict
  inverse codecs; `content_hash` computed when absent; conditioned-rule
  debt decodes via the full schema codec (`debt_from_json` is now
  `pub` — the event-payload helper silently dropped `removal_test` and
  the other additive members).
- Offline-decidable arms select per declared guards:
  `static`/`role_table`/`fallback_chain`/`capability_filter` over the
  realized table; `cost_cap` under a declared pricing view (typed
  refusal without); `latency_cap`/`quality_target`/`bandit`/
  `health_aware` evaluate declared members and refuse the live-signal
  ones; `learned` refuses absent bound evolution evidence. No missing
  view is ever coerced to healthy/zero/available.

## Probes + K5 + staged failures (D5–D6)

Declared `probes[]` mint `model.profile.probed` durable before the
first call (plus `model.profile.status.changed{trigger: probe}` on a
declared-status contradiction). The `response_cache` slot binds
`KernelK5` — one `model.cache.resolved` per lookup, scoped to its
call; a hit serves the recorded document under the entry ref. The
`model_fail[]` script stages call outcomes (`{class, retry_after_ms?}`
| `{}` pass) — a drained plan means success, nothing fabricates a
failure; a durable resume re-arms the script whole. Slot params spell
the policy target `candidate` — `model_ref`/`version` in a semantic
projection trip T-LCD-01 (D7).

## Dialect corpus (R-2.3.1)

The AC-R-2.3.1-2 corpus (13 shapes × 2 provider-faithful families)
landed at S3.7; R2.7 adds the in-battery codec cell — both family
documents round-trip through `WireDialect/1` verbatim with stable
`content_id`, and an unknown member refuses
(`r2_7_dialect_documents_codec_round_trip`).
